g.text: Prospective relation prediction and sensitivity to strong projection disorder
A: context combinations are lexical set × template × order; they are not independent lexical worlds. B: medians over n=4 contexts at each dose; no confidence intervals. The post-held
disorder assay tests final L22/L23 value-projection correspondence, not training chronology or whole-model weights.
